title: Finite-pattern factorization in a completed positive monoid algebra
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $P$ be a finitely generated commutative additive monoid [lem-trf-fg-commutative-monoid-finite-presentation] embedded in a free abelian group [lem-trf-fg-torsionfree-group-free], and let $w$ be strictly positive on $P\setminus\{0\}$. Let $B=A^P$ be the ring of coefficient families with convolution, let $z^p$ denote the family supported at $p$ with coefficient $1$, and let $\mathfrak b\subset B$ be the ideal generated by the constant families from $\mathfrak m$ and by the $z^p$ for $p
e0$. Define $
u(p)$ as the maximal number of nonzero summands in a decomposition of $p$, with $
u(0)=0$. For every $n\ge1$, every family $(a_p)_{p\in P}$ satisfying $a_p\in\mathfrak m^{\max(n-
u(p),0)}$ for all $p$ belongs to $\mathfrak b^nB$.
